part_c_ablation.reading: Every decision is load-bearing. Windowing is the strongest: without it the guard both MISSES eval_318 and SPURIOUSLY flags eval_323, whose bodies attribute no figure to their sibling and are correct as written — i.e. removing it would blank a good body on a live corpus row.

engine amount is the EMPLOYEE SHARE (80,000); the 20% TOTAL is equally correct and the working spells out the split that sums to it

the payroll BASE appears after the levy name; the correct result is also present
band bases and intermediate figures in the body must not be read as sibling results
